_comment: World-famous landmark names force-kept in enrichment even when Overture tags them as a generic building (Empire State Building is category 'landmark_and_historical_building', indistinguishable by confidence from luxury apartment towers). Matched by normalized exact name (lowercased, leading 'the' stripped), only against POIs in Overture's attractions_and_activities group, so a restaurant sharing a name is not force-named. Curated by hand for now; intended to be maintained by an LLM agent later. NYC scope.
